steps.help: Step 1 of 4: This is your account settings page where you can update your personal information, preferences, and password.
Step 2 of 4: Update your display name, phone number, and profile color. Your email address cannot be changed - it's your login ID.
Step 3 of 4: Enable or disable the AI chatbot assistant, and set your preferred language for the interface.
Step 4 of 4: Click "Save Changes" to apply your updates. Your settings will be saved immediately.
